mapper.update: UPDATE squad_chat.sq_mcp_server_version SET transport_type = #{transportType}, endpoint = #{endpoint}, credential_ref = #{credentialRef}, revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE mcp_server_id = #{mcpServerId} AND mcp_server_version_id = #{mcpServerVersionId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND revision = #{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(v.mcp_server_version_id AS varchar) AS mcp_server_version_id, s.server_name, v.version_no FROM squad_chat.sq_mcp_server_version v JOIN squad_chat.sq_mcp_server s ON s.mcp_server_id = v.mcp_server_id WHERE v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY s.server_code, v.version_no DESC
